    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACKed, but raised concerns on test scope, placement of BIP113 tests, unexplained diffs, and incomplete UINT32_MAX edge-case coverage"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:2037158499",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "a test assertion could pass due to a duplicate transaction rather than the timelock failure being tested",
      "quote": "Otherwise, the check at line 218 could succeed not for the timelock (that is what we expect) but because of the duplicated transaction.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:2794588008"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:2794588008",
      "settled_by_quote": "I've integrated your code review in 024c3bf"
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3991003329",
      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "general BIP113 MTP/finality tests were misplaced in feature_cltv.py, and existing locktime test coverage was inaccurate in the description",
      "quote": "Can you re-formulate the PR description to make it clear what this actually tests? Contrary to your current description, it looks like we are already testing unix timestamp values in the locktime extensively. Are the finality tests better suited for feature_csv_activation?",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4355285338",
        "c:4887288553"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:4887288553",
      "settled_by_quote": "Split the UINT32_MAX / median-time-past edge case out of feature_cltv.py and into feature_csv_activation.py, since that behavior is a general BIP113 property and not specific to OP_CLTV"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4027208332",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "harm": "unnecessary modifications to lines in feature_cltv.py that do not alter test behavior add review overhead and noise",
      "quote": "Why is this line changed? Seems like it is not actually changing anything behaviour wise.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4027859196",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "the MTP edge case test in feature_csv_activation.py misses testing that a UINT32_MAX - 1 timelocked tx enters the mempool once MTP maxes out but cannot be mined",
      "quote": "The interesting case in my eyes is that on the final block, a UINT32_MAX - 1 timelocked transaction is considered standard and enters the mempool, but can't ever be mined.",
      "blocking": false,
      "status": "open",
      "author_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "settled_by_id": "",
      "settled_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4518177621",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "fine with having a test for documenting the UINT32_MAX MTP calculation edge case",
      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Initial record for PR 32229. sedited provided a Concept ACK and previous placement concerns were resolved, but nonblocking questions regarding no-op test diffs and a suggested patch to cover mempool behavior for UINT32_MAX - 1 remain open without author reply."
}
